Why does a used car cost over $27,000?
The average used listing was $27,239 in August 2026 (Cox Automotive).
A parts shortage held 2022 new-vehicle sales to 13.9 million, and leasing fell from 27.82% of new vehicles (Q2 2021) to 19.65% (Q2 2022), so fewer nearly new cars come back off lease about three years later.
A 3-year-old used car averaged $32,461 in Q2 2026, and used cars under $20,000 fell from 55.2% of sales (Q2 2019) to 31.8% (Q2 2026). The average used loan rate was 11.19% in Q2 2026.
Sources: Cox Automotive, Edmunds, Experian.
